name: Women for Aryan Unity
description: Women for Aryan Unity (WAU) is a longstanding white supremacist organization, founded in 1990, notable for being one of the only female-only white supremacist groups of recent decades. WAU promotes and supports women in the white supremacist movement from a traditionalist vantage point, with content in its newsletters and websites focusing on domestic and child-rearing topics. The group has also provided support to white supremacist prison inmates, particularly those viewed as political prisoners of war.
